summary: Timeboxed, minimal prod inference telemetry view for Regulatory Evidence Package (privacy-safe)
description:
Issue summary:
Requesting timeboxed, read-only access to a minimized slice of production inference telemetry and aggregated request metadata to assemble a Regulatory Evidence Package for an upcoming audit. The Compliance team needs this data to demonstrate routing controls, model version pinning, and absence of cross-customer leakage for a specific feature set.

Impact:
- Low risk if data is properly minimized and redacted; however access to prod traces requires strict controls.
- Purpose is regulatory evidence collection, not debugging or incident replay. No full session payloads requested.

Request details (what we need):
1) A sampled, schema-aware export (CSV/JSONL) of inference meta-records for the window 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-15 for us-west-2 only.
2) Records limited to route IDs: feature/enterprise-chat-v2 and feature/secure-embeds.
3) Fields to include (ONLY): timestamp, route_id, model_version, latency_ms_p50,p90, p99, response_status, billing_tier, hashed_account_id (HMAC-SHA256 with team KMS key), and a boolean flag for prefix-kv-cache-hit.
4) No plaintext request/response bodies, no raw tokens, no user-provided strings.
5) Hashing key must be KMS-wrapped with the Compliance team key; raw keys must never be exported.
6) Maximum sample rate: 2% per route, deterministic sampling seed provided by Compliance to allow reproducibility.
7) Export file must be staged in an encrypted S3 bucket with object-level KMS encryption and access limited to a dual-approval set (Marco Rinaldi and Security reviewer).
8) Access window: read-only for 72 hours after approval, after which exports and temporary credentials must be revoked and export copies purged per retention plan below.

Data minimization & safeguards:
- No PII or free-text fields will be included. Hashed_account_id only; no mapping table will be provided in the export.
- All queries and export jobs must run in a dedicated, ephemeral role with least privilege and CloudTrail logging enabled.
- Before release, Security will run an automated pattern-scan to assert no accidental free-text fields are present.

Retention & audit:
- Export artifacts retained for 7 days post-download then securely deleted.
- All accesses must be logged; Compliance will provide a list of reviewers and the download must be auditable.

Approvals required:
- Dual approval from Security (security@redwood.com) and Data Governance (dgov@redwood.com).
- Inform SRE oncall to monitor any job impact during the export window.

Acceptance criteria:
- Export contains only the allowed fields and shows the sampling rate.
- Security automated scan returns zero findings for free-text/PII.
- Compliance confirms receipt and that the artifacts meet regulatory documentation needs.

Follow-up tasks post-access:
- Confluence short summary of artifacts produced and retention confirmation.
- Add a short note to the Evidence Index with export checksum and reviewers.

Notes/constraints:
- This is NOT a full session trace export; if debugging is required a separate, more restrictive workflow must be followed.
- If downstream validation uncovers a need for additional fields, a new ticket and re-approval must be requested.
